essence: The ritual assigns the sun to the mirror and the water-lord to the full pot.
The ritual assigns the pure one to the conch and the fire-carrier to the lamp.
A pair of chowrie fans should be placed in the eastern and western parts.
One may omit the eight auspicious objects and worship substitutes in their place.
One may have a banner, mace, lotus, or discus made.
